contract.goal: Phase A for the rank-1 collection. Guard: ragclient.py and score.py must match RUN/serial_gate.json (mismatch => no tenant calls, collection-terminal bound_hit 'harness_integrity', never re-pin); never touch the token; write_file only in RUN; RUN_STOP or a collection-terminal status in RUN/r1/state.json => no tenant call, record, return. Needs a frozen benchmark and noise floor. Tuning set only, cheap sweep model, pool=search, one collection, use_graph explicit. First record the phase-A call cap = 1200 - setup used - phase-B reservation (non-struck multi-call structures x tuning n x smoke billable per question, plus one single_shot rerun, at most half the remaining search budget). Prior = baseline_v0; the current best moves only on an effect-sized gain. Screening via POST /v1/retrieve on mean document_coverage_at_k (independent axes may share an iteration): retrieval_mode hybrid/vector/bm25; top_k 5/10/20/30; rerank false/true; rerank_candidates 20/50/100 and reranker models only if rerank is kept. Pass = coverage >= current best minus the doc-coverage floor (0.05 if unset); others screened-out with coverage. Screening is never coverage. Generation trial = full tuning run via /v1/query changing exactly one axis from a named prior (multi-axis = exploratory). Every applicable axis needs >=1 scored trial: retrieval_mode, top_k, rerank, context_window (1-3 vs 0), use_graph (true only in its own trial on attributable collections; kept only if it beat the floor), template (id, version, hash), query_rewrite (HyDE, multi-query; record rewritten_queries), plus rerank_candidates and reranker only if rerank kept. Retrieval-axis trial value: the best passing non-prior value; for top_k the smallest passing value within the doc-coverage floor of the maximum (a second top_k value may follow after coverage). If no non-prior value passes, the axis is covered by the prior's existing trial id, recorded as 'alternatives screened-out', with no paid trial. Earlier-rank findings may reorder axes or pick first values, never skip. Verdict: |delta| > effective floor (2x if low-power) = effect, else within-noise. Normal stop: coverage complete AND (tuning synthesis_completeness >= 0.9 OR 3 consecutive distinct-axis trials each gaining < max(0.05, floor)). Any other end (call cap, time, iteration, judging cap, host target or stagnation) is a phase bound: record it, mark unscored axes not-tested, hand the current best to phase B. Score with score.py's frozen aggregation and attribution rules and /v1/chunks resolution; the Episode's own model judges only under the frozen blinded judging prompt. Classes: correct_grounded, incomplete_synthesis (never correct), retrieval_coverage_miss, unsupported_citation, wrong, truncated (separate), retrieval_only_placeholder and transient_error (excluded, counted). Never touch the holdout. Write outcome rows (answer, cited doc_ids and chunk_ids, distinct-doc count, verdict, failure class, truncated flag), the screening table, and leaderboard rows (phase, axis, prior id, full parameter vector, tuning completeness, doc coverage, citation support, verdict, excluded count, cost vector); record Wa, stop reason and per-axis coverage in state.

(5) Run token_leak_scan() over RUN and /Users/me/.hermes/cache/scratch and write the hashed scan record. (6) Write RUN/ROOT_MANIFEST.json listing every RUN file (including the scan record) with SHA-256, and its SHA-256 in RUN/ROOT_MANIFEST.sha256. (7) Last, run token_leak_scan() on the two manifest files and write RUN/ROOT_MANIFEST.scan.json (hash reported separately). On any match, record the root as blocked with credential_leak_detected, delete nothing, and surface only the matching paths.
